claim: Through an interface VPC endpoint you can call all user pools API operations, but not the user pool OAuth 2.0 authorization server (domain endpoints), so client credentials (M2M) grants and managed login do not go through AWS PrivateLink.
question: Which Amazon Cognito user pool requests can go through an interface VPC endpoint?

evidence.quote: You can make requests to all user pools API operations through the interface endpoint, but not to operations that your application requests from the user pool OAuth 2.0 authorization server for example client credentials grants and managed login.

claim: Amazon Cognito identity pools support all API operations through AWS PrivateLink; identity pools have no domain endpoints.
question: Which Amazon Cognito identity pool operations can go through AWS PrivateLink?

values.display: support all API operations through AWS PrivateLink

evidence.quote: Amazon Cognito identity pools support all API operations through AWS PrivateLink.
Identity pools don't have domain endpoints and aren't subject to the same limitations.
